info.title: Pilketum BCC 2026 API (as used by the frontend)
info.description: Generated from src/lib/api/contract.ts by `pnpm contract:openapi`. Do not edit by hand. Source: the backend doc "API Pilketum BCC"; open points in docs/BACKEND_QUESTIONS.md.

get.summary: Voting status for the sign-in page (not_started, open, closed) and server time
Payload of the screen on air, nothing else
Server-sent events: the /display payload on connect and on every change

200.description: Server-sent events. Each `event: display` carries JSON matching x-event-data

post.summary: UB SSO sign-in with NIM or UB email. Either a session or an OTP challenge (2FA)

200.x-frontend: The Next server keeps `token` in an httpOnly cookie and removes token/expires_at from the body

post.summary: Second step for 2FA accounts. OTP_INVALID returns a new flow

200.x-frontend: The Next server keeps `token` in an httpOnly cookie and removes token/expires_at from the body

get.summary: The signed-in voter (has_voted) and the voting status
All candidates with vision and missions, by ballot number

post.summary: Casts the vote. Final. The backend keeps no link between voter and candidate

200.x-frontend: The Next server keeps `token` in an httpOnly cookie and removes token/expires_at from the body

get.summary: Status, screen on air, candidate count, turnout. Never votes per candidate
Server-sent events: the /admin/overview payload on change (the panel polls instead)

200.description: Server-sent events. Each `event: overview` carries JSON matching x-event-data

post.summary: open (not_started→open, needs 3 complete candidates), close (open→closed), reopen (closed→open)

put.summary: Puts a result screen on the public display. Only while closed

get.summary: Payload of a screen without putting it on air
Voter list page. search matches name, email or NIM
Votes per candidate, leaders, ties, integrity check. Only while closed
Excel file (Summary, Results, Voters). Only while closed

post.summary: Adds a candidate. Only before voting first opens; ballot numbers 1–3

delete.summary: Removes a candidate and its photo

put.summary: Uploads the photo (multipart field "photo", JPG/PNG up to 2 MB)
